title: A Health Score Is Not an Intervention Trigger
excerpt: Replace noisy account alerts with an explicit rule that connects observed change, customer consequence, evidence quality, and a response someone can actually own.
primary_goal: Help CS leaders decide which leading account signal justifies intervention before a composite health score changes.
primary_cta: Define one account intervention in the Intervention Trigger Ledger.
playbook_description: A practical record for turning one observed customer change into a bounded, actionable and reviewable intervention rule.

subject_variants.label: problem
subject_variants.subject: Your health score changed. Now what?

subject_variants.label: outcome
subject_variants.subject: Only alert CS when the action is clear
